scope: Exploratory comparison only; does not authorize fast authoritative solver mode or alter the strict parity gate.
trace_sampling: Every production physics frame, stable harness-assigned drink identity, fixed 60 physics ticks per second.

strict_gate.name: strict_bitwise_physics_parity
pass_conditions: same ordered stable entity identities and exact serialized per-frame state hashes
same ordered per-frame contact and merge event cursors
same complete ordered contact and merge event ledgers
same objective, terminal, spawn, action, and branch records
strict_gate.effect: A strict failure remains a parity failure and keeps fast authoritative solver mode disabled.

exploratory_tolerant_gate.name: tolerant_candidate_only
structural_requirements: identity set and order are identical at every frame
motion_state and sleeping state are identical for each identity
contact and merge event identity, order, and frame are identical
objectives, terminal result, spawn levels, actions, policy decisions, and branching records are identical
exploratory_tolerant_gate.effect: Candidate classification only; it is not a parity pass, solver authority, or permission to relax strict parity.

unknown_conditions: process timeout or budget exit before a terminal result
high-density minimum of eight live drinks not reached
adversarial_test: Mutate one branch lane and one collision target identity while keeping numeric deltas within tolerance; tolerant gate must reject both as structural divergence.
authoritative_trial: If strict parity is not demonstrated, at most one normal-speed production-physics exact-4T diagnostic with external 12-second wall deadline; unknown is not impossible.
